name: peerpush
description: Find, compare, and discover software, SaaS, and AI tools with structured pricing, platform, and alternatives data.

interface.longDescription:
PeerPush helps you discover software products, SaaS tools, developer tools, AI tools, and apps. Ask in plain language and PeerPush searches its structured product data: pricing model, platforms, use cases, and target audiences.

What you can do:
- Find alternatives to a product you already use
- Search for tools that fit a specific need or platform
- Compare 2 to 5 products side by side
- Look up a product's platforms, features, and recent updates
- See what is trending or newly launched

All tools are read-only and need no account. PeerPush never takes actions on your behalf.

Every listing is moderated. Products are reviewed when they are submitted and whenever they are edited, and products in prohibited categories, such as gambling, adult content, drugs, weapons, or piracy, are removed from PeerPush.

How results are ranked: searches are ordered by relevance. Optional score-based ordering uses PeerPush points from community engagement (upvotes, reviews, activity) and from launch boosts that product owners can add on peerpush.com.
